title: Cloudflare WARP
serviceDown: The WARP service is not running
notRegistered: This device is not registered with WARP
setupInstallDetail: Opens a terminal that installs Cloudflare WARP from the AUR, starts its service and registers this device. It asks for your password, and asks before accepting Cloudflare's terms.
setupServiceDetail: Opens a terminal that starts the warp-svc service now and at every boot. It asks for your password.
setupRegisterDetail: Opens a terminal that registers this device with a free WARP account. It asks before accepting Cloudflare's terms.
modeProxyDetail: SOCKS5 proxy only, apps opt in
